subject: GreenTech pilot: demo scheduling & cross-region coverage
messages:
From: Sarah Hunt <sarah.hunt@greentech.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T13:08:00-05:00
Subject: Re: GreenTech pilot — demo availability

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for following up. We're excited to see Redwood in action. Our team is constrained on the East Coast with a tight morning standup window, and our CTO (US West) prefers early local mornings (around 8:00 PT). That translates to late evening for your EU engineers, which is a little rough.

Would you be open to a short demo series (3 x 30 minutes) spread over a couple of days so we can include folks in both timezones without asking any one person to be on at midnight? If not, we can pick one longer session — but we want to avoid forcing our EU counterparts into late nights.

Attached is a short RFP summary so you can see the areas we'd want covered.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Hunt
Director, Platform & Integration
GreenTech Energy
Attachments: GreenTech_RFP_scope.pdf (pdf, 320KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Hunt <sarah.hunt@greentech.com>, scheduling@greentech.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T16:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: GreenTech pilot — demo availability

Hi Sarah — thanks for the RFP and the context. Totally understand not wanting to put EU folks into late-night slots. We can do a rolling short-series approach which our engineers have done successfully for other multi-region customers. Two practical formats we can offer:  

Option A — Staggered 3x30m across two days (recommended):
 - Day 1: Intro + infra & compliance (30m) — 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET / 20:00 CET (works for EU PMs)
 - Day 2: Deep-dive on latency/cost, plus Q&A (60m split into 30m + 30m) — 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 17:00 CET (easier for US morning; EU late afternoon)

Option B — Single 60–75m in a slot that favors US West (early morning PT) with recording and a follow-up office-hours slot for EU engineers the next day.

We can record all sessions and provide a short (10–15m) on-demand walkthrough for any teammates who can’t join live. I attached a proposed agenda and a timezone coverage grid to show who would be impacted.

Would you prefer Option A (spread series) or Option B (single recorded + follow-up)? If Option A, what days next week work best for you?

Thanks — I’ll coordinate hosts once you confirm.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed-agenda-rolling-demo.pdf, timezone-coverage-grid.csv

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T19:04:00+01:00
Subject: Re: GreenTech pilot — internal host coverage

Stef / team — I can cover a Day 2 early-morning PT slot from infra/runtime perspective, but I'm on-call that week and would prefer not to take the late-evening CET shift (18:00+ CET) if possible.

Soojin, Jonas — can one of you take the Day 1 evening CET-friendly session? If we split it like Stephanie suggested we only need short focused hosts per session (PM + infra engineer). I can provide the latency slides and a canned demo recording to fill any gaps.

Aditya
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Sarah Hunt <sarah.hunt@greentech.com>

> Stef / team — I can cover a Day 2 early-morning PT slot from infra/runtime perspective, but I'm on-call that week and would prefer not to take the late-evening CET shift (18:00+ CET) if possible.

Hi all — I can take Day 1 (CET-friendly) on Dec 2 at 20:00 CET (11:00 ET / 08:00 PT) for the intro + compliance session. I’ll coordinate with Aditya for the runtime slides so we don’t duplicate.

Sarah — if that time works for you we’ll set up calendar invites and split the agenda into 30-minute checkpoints so folks can join only the pieces they need. We’ll also keep a 45-minute optional office hours the following morning for EU follow-up (short Q&A).

Soojin
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Sarah
